propositions: The dedup key for outbound Jira comments is currently derived from a predicted composition of fit and encoding functions rather than from the bytes actually sent, causing drift when the three separate compositions (differ, Cloud adapter, DC adapter) diverge.

The differ builds the key from decorated, fitted, encoded text but appends only the un-fitted body to the mutation, while send paths independently re-derive the wire, creating a three-way synchronization obligation.

Both mutation-enactment consumers (create path in dispatch_one.py and update path in dispatch_apply_phases.py) must be updated together to read wire_body from the mutation entry, or half the traffic will continue sending un-fitted text while the key came from fitted text.
Re-fitting an already-fitted comment must return it byte-identical (idempotence), so the adapter's defensive fit does not move the bytes after the key was taken.
